CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

2. Which response best shows understanding of Making choices? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Making choices with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Making choices.
   C. Say Making choices has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Making choices to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
